name: graphcommerce/magento-graphql-catalog
description: Catalog GraphQL fields for Magento 2 / Mage-OS: one custom attribute by code, the attribute metadata of a value and an aggregation, the swatch of every option, a configurable option selection that follows the listing filter, and the quantity per stock source. One package with every module; each module directory is a package of its own for a subtree split.

suggest.magento/module-swatches-graph-ql: GraphCommerce_GraphQlCatalogSwatches serves the swatch of an aggregation option, an attribute option and a selected option
suggest.magento/module-configurable-product-grap: GraphCommerce_GraphQlCatalogConfigurableProduct selects the configurable options the listing filter names
suggest.magento/module-inventory-sales-api: GraphCommerce_GraphQlCatalogInventory serves the quantity per source of the stock of the website
